baseline.name: Frequency array for 1..n
baseline.approach: Count every value and scan the n counters for the zero and repeated count.
baseline.space: O(n) auxiliary counters plus the two-value result

archived.name: XOR partition plus duplicate identification
archived.space: O(1) auxiliary space; a two-integer returned allocation

why: XOR cancels matched values and separates the two anomalies using one distinguishing bit, avoiding n frequency counters.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline stores n+1 counters. The archive has constant-sized counters/masks and a two-value result, using two complete XOR/partition passes and up to one more input scan. Both have linear work growth; a speed improvement is not established.
tradeoffs: Requires exactly one duplicate and one missing value in the stated range. XOR reasoning is less direct than frequency counting, and the result allocation is unchecked.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
